TemplateContent.Subject: Complete your Yahtzee Hub account
TemplateContent.Text:
You recently started creating a Yahtzee Hub account with this email address, but the email address has not yet been verified.

To finish setting up your account, return to Yahtzee Hub and enter your verification code. If the code has expired, choose Resend verification code.

Return to Yahtzee Hub: {{accountUrl}}

If you did not start creating this account, you can ignore this email. No account will become active unless the email address is verified.

This is an account service message, not a marketing email.
